record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: OnSimulationStartEffect (shared instance) that wires ally-death counting and a one-time stat transformation
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.FINIZEN] holds one shared OnSimulationStartEffect. At simulation start, for an entity not already named PALAFIN_HERO, it counts the other entities of its team on the board (nbAllies) and adds one shared OnDeathEffect to each of them. Every death of a wired ally increments nbAlliesKo; when nbAlliesKo reaches 5 or the initial ally count (whichever is first) and the transformation has not happened, transformToHero runs once. With no allies at start it runs immediately. transformToHero renames the entity to PALAFIN_HERO (name and index), requests +18 attack, +16 speed, +5 defense and +5 special defense through addAttack, addSpeed, addDefense and addSpecialDefense (caster = the unit, apBoost 0, no crit, not permanent), and sets hp = maxHP directly. For a player-owned non-ghost entity whose board Pokemon is still named FINIZEN, it also replaces the board Pokemon by PALAFIN via player.transformPokemon. A resurrection effect re-applies transformToHero if the transformation had happened. All stat amounts are requested raw amounts; item helpers and clamps can change what is applied (see effects).
triggers: OnSimulationStartEffect: once per entity after the board is set up (wiring, and immediate transformation when alone)
OnDeathEffect on each other same-team entity present at simulation start: every ally death while not yet transformed
OnResurrectionEffect on the unit: re-applies the transformation when it had already happened

effects.declaredRaw: transformation when 5 wired allies have died, or when as many allies have died as were counted at start (nbAllies); immediate when nbAllies is 0
effects.scaling: none: counts only; no AP, star or stat dependency
effects.resolution: nbAllies counts every other same-team entity on the board at simulation start (id differs from the unit), whatever its type; only those entities carry the OnDeathEffect. nbAlliesKo increases by one per OnDeath call of a wired ally, so an ally that dies, is resurrected and dies again is counted again. Entities spawned after the start are neither counted nor wired. The threshold is min(5, nbAllies) because both comparisons are >=.

effects.declaredRaw: requested +18 attack, +16 speed, +5 defense, +5 special defense, once; name and index become PALAFIN_HERO
effects.scaling: none from AP or crit (apBoost 0, crit false, caster = the unit). Each helper rounds, then applies Big Eater Belt (positive value x1.25 rounded down to 0 digits: 18 becomes 22, 16 becomes 20, 5 becomes 6) when the holder has one, and Twist Band only flips negatives. addSpeed applies the belt before its multiplier; a MELMETAL passive would redirect speed to half attack (not applicable to these units).
effects.resolution: requested +18 / +16 / +5 / +5; applied = the same without a Big Eater Belt; stored attack = max(1, atk + 18), defense and special defense = max(0, current + 5), speed = clamp(speed + 16, 0, 300). Without belts, from the class base stats (atk 12, speed 64, def 7, speDef 6) the result is atk 30, speed 80, def 12, speDef 11, which equals the PALAFIN_HERO class block values; combat-time modifiers present on the entity at that moment (synergies, items, status) are not included in that arithmetic. hp is then set to maxHP directly: this is not handleHeal, so wound, status.protect and heal modifiers do not apply, and it does not add to healDone.

effects.declaredRaw: board Pokemon FINIZEN replaced by PALAFIN (stays on the board for the planning phase after the fight)
effects.resolution: only when entity.player exists, the entity is not a ghost opponent and entity.refToBoardPokemon.name is FINIZEN at transform time; transformPokemon removes the old board Pokemon, creates PALAFIN, carries over permanent stats and re-gives the items, and adds PALAFIN_HERO to the player's pokemonsPlayed set. A unit already named PALAFIN gets the in-fight transformation but no board change.

effects.declaredRaw: transformToHero again when the unit is resurrected after having transformed
effects.resolution: resurrect() first recomputes stats from a rebuilt clone and sets hp to maxHP, then runs OnResurrection effects, so the same four stat requests are applied again (belt and clamps as above); transformed stays true. If the transformation had not happened, nothing is applied.
